intro: If you're arriving in Surin by train and want a clean, spacious, affordable room you can walk to, Maneerote Hotel Surin is a name that comes up often in reviews · It's a 3-star hotel that opened in 2010 on Soi Poi Tangko, Krung Si Nai Road, in central Surin · Rooms run a generous 32 sqm, with fast Wi-Fi 6, the in-house Muang Chang Coffee café and free parking — from around ฿470/night · Real guest reviews praise the cleanliness, the spacious rooms and the helpful staff, while most gripes are minor — water temperature and small bathroom details.

body.html: Maneerote Hotel has been operating since 2010, at 11/1 Soi Poi Tangko, Krung Si Nai Road, Nai Mueang, in central Surin · It's a 72-room, 3-star hotel that positions itself clearly as an affordable stay that's cleaner and more modern than its price suggests · What sets it apart from a typical guesthouse is the generous 32 sqm rooms, a long work desk, and fast per-room Wi-Fi 6 — handy for anyone travelling for work who needs the internet to actually hold up.

Rooms come in several types, from Standard Single, Standard Double and Standard Twin up to Superior Double and a Family Room for three · What guests mention consistently is that the rooms are more spacious than expected for the price, clean, with soft beds and good shower pressure · Every room has air-con, a flat-screen TV and a fridge, and some have a balcony with a city view · The trade-off is that this is a budget hotel — no pool or gym, and some bathroom details remain basic.
"Very clean room, bigger than I expected, soft bed, fast internet I could work on, lovely helpful staff, and the café downstairs is good value — excellent for the price."

A detail many reviews single out is the in-house restaurant and Muang Chang Coffee café, open for coffee, breakfast and lunch-to-dinner meals · Prices are friendly and it's convenient if you'd rather not head out to find food · Breakfast is offered buffet or à la carte depending on the package · The front desk is open 24 hours with room service, and there's free parking wide enough for vans — a real plus if you're driving in.

Location is the main reason people choose it · It's in central Surin, within walking distance of Surin Train Station, and a short walk from the City Pillar Shrine and Surin Plaza · The day and night markets are close, so finding Isaan food on foot is easy · It's ideal for anyone arriving by train or coach without their own car, since you can walk straight from the station to the hotel · It also works as a base for visiting temples, browsing the markets, or heading out to the elephant village and Khmer ruins around town.

To be honest, per real guest sentiment: Maneerote is a budget hotel that scores well on cleanliness and value, but it isn't a luxury stay · The common gripes are small — water temperature that's tricky to set in some rooms, no in-room safe, and occasional mix-ups over room assignment or whether breakfast is included · Guests who are disappointed usually expected luxury-hotel standards, while those who understand they're booking an affordable central 3-star tend to be happy with the spacious, clean rooms and fast internet.

In short, if you want a clean central Surin base with spacious rooms, fast Wi-Fi, an in-house café, free parking and a walk-from-the-station location, starting at just a few hundred baht — Maneerote is a sensible pick · Its 8.2 score from 52 Trip.com reviews (Cleanliness 8.4, Service 8.3, Location 8.3) captures the picture accurately: "clean, spacious, good value, good location" · It suits business travellers, solo travellers and budget-minded tourists using Surin as a base alike.

A tip from following the reviews here: ask for a renovated Superior room and flag the hot water at check-in if you're particular about showers · Confirm whether breakfast is included before booking to avoid confusion · And if you're visiting during the Surin Elephant Round-up (mid-November), book several weeks ahead, as in-town and near-station rooms fill up fast.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Maneerote Hotel Surin

faq.q: Where is Maneerote Hotel Surin, and can I walk from the train station?
faq.a: Maneerote Hotel is at 11/1 Soi Poi Tangko, Krung Si Nai Road, Nai Mueang, in central Surin · It's roughly a 10-minute walk from Surin Train Station, near the City Pillar Shrine and Surin Plaza · It's ideal for anyone arriving by train or coach without their own car.

faq.q: How much does Maneerote Hotel Surin cost, and what rooms are available?
faq.a: Rates start at around ฿470/night for a Standard Single · A Standard Double runs about ฿520, a Superior Double around ฿559 and a Family Room for three around ฿790 · Prices vary by date and platform, and rise during the Surin Elephant Round-up — compare Agoda, Booking and Trip.com before booking.

faq.q: Are the rooms at Maneerote Hotel Surin clean and spacious?
faq.a: Most reviews praise the cleanliness and the generous 32 sqm rooms, which are larger than expected for the price · There's a long work desk and fast Wi-Fi 6, soft beds and good shower pressure · Its Trip.com cleanliness score is 8.4, high for a budget hotel · One caveat: hot water can be tricky to set in some rooms, so flag it with staff.

faq.q: Who is Maneerote Hotel Surin best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for solo travellers, business travellers and budget-minded tourists using Surin as a base — especially those arriving by train, since you can walk from the station · Wi-Fi 6 suits working travellers and free parking suits drivers · It's not for those wanting a pool, gym or luxury-hotel standards.

faq.q: Does Maneerote Hotel Surin have a restaurant and breakfast?
faq.a: Yes — there's an in-house restaurant and Muang Chang Coffee café open for coffee, breakfast, lunch and dinner at friendly prices · Breakfast is offered buffet or à la carte depending on the package, so confirm whether it's included when you book.

faq.q: How far ahead should I book, especially for the Surin Elephant Round-up?
faq.a: In normal periods, 1–2 weeks ahead is fine · But for the Surin Elephant Round-up in mid-November, book several weeks ahead, as in-town and near-station rooms fill fast · Every platform offers a Free Cancellation option — choose that if your plans aren't firm yet.
